semanticChecks: Clothing supports skin, seasons/activity, rhythm/social life and personal expression; person choice is not worker preference. Morikawa chooses thin jacket after sleeve inspection; permission to retrieve, planned self-buttoning, retrieval and changing are distinct. Explicit daughter red-hat suggestion versus person white-hat choice retained without inferred kinship elsewhere.

Hemiplegic examples retain dress affected side/undress unaffected side to reduce affected movement, individual suitability, shoulder/wrist protection and training. Upper garment, trousers, sitting, standing and lying methods remain separate; threading legs does not prove unsupported standing. No pulling limbs, both legs raised together, entrapped affected arm or garments used to pull body.

Lying garment sequence retains unaffected sleeve removal, fabric gathered inward under body, unaffected-side-down turning, affected sleeve removal; dressing affected sleeve/fabric/authorized turn/unaffected sleeve. Fabric folds, seams, affected position, pain and comfort checked at end; example is not universal to all injuries/pain.

Oral care retains cleanliness, caries/periodontal/odor prevention, saliva/dryness/taste/appetite and qualified aspiration-pneumonia prevention, never a guarantee. Stable posture, no chin overextension, head support and affected-side food residue remain. Unknown rinse/spit/swallow ability does not authorize much water. Pencil grip, gentle tooth-by-tooth surfaces, sponge assessment and oral observations preserved.

Full versus partial dentures, owner identity, distinct retention/placement/removal, product/material/dental instructions, post-meal cleaning and remaining teeth/mouth care remain. No boiling, force fitting/biting, bending metal, identity-by-color or universal night rule. Pain/swelling/bleeding explicitly go to medical professionals.

Case body labelled Hasebe differs from unconfirmed differently colored lid; no opening, contents transfer, use or placement. Hasebe remains in room with assigned worker; nurse Fujino and assigned staff check. Tooth pain began yesterday evening; planned nurse contact/appointment confirmation is not completed contact/reservation.

Skin epidermis/dermis/subcutaneous fat, sweat versus sebaceous glands and eccrine versus apocrine distribution retained. Bathing benefits remain state-dependent; rapid temperature-change shock differs from heat illness. Room/water temperature, wet floor, privacy, equipment, meals/toileting/drink and individual plan all remain separate checks.

Bath entry, sitting and exit retain different checks, affected-side flotation, orthostatic risk, trained individual support/equipment/staffing, unaffected-extremity-to-trunk shower example and unaffected-side entry. Fatigue/dizziness prompts safe help rather than rushing to complete.

09:25curtain off rail and entrance water observed; room/water temperatures and tub unconfirmed. Onodera in activity room with assigned staff. Kishimoto contacts equipment staff; reporter informs Kawase; no guidance before response and recheck. Yesterday cold differs from current statement; current okay does not finish all checks.

Nails:10:15left-thumb snag statement differs from unobserved nail/skin/pain and absent consent. Hasebe seated in room with Kishimoto, nurse Fujino receives prompt report, no cutting/drugs; alternate right-foot scene is not changed to left thumb. Square-tip versus deep/side cutting examples remain knowledge, not license for diseased nail treatment.

Face washing retains gentle clean surfaces, inner-to-outer eye direction, no reused dirty surface on opposite eye, ear/neck checks, no soap/water in eyes, clinical reporting and no independent eye drops. Shaving/makeup retain personal choice, product/skin/hygiene checks, pain/abrasion/bleeding response and no expanded consent to new product/blade.

Full bath, hand/foot bath, face washing and full/partial wiping are different activities/consent scopes. Onodera refuses full bath, wants face only, reports post-activity fatigue; notify Kawase now, do not delay for conversation, no method yet approved and neither support begun. Consent must follow concrete method explanation.

Hand/foot baths retain stable supported posture, actual water/skin/sensation checks, no forced joint reach, hotter/longer nail-softening or assumed safety from diminished sensation. Wiping retains sequential body sites, separate genital area, clean/used distinction, soap removal/drying/recovering each site, privacy/warmth and exact performed scope.

Intimate care retains female urethral-to-anal direction, trained individualized male care without guessed deep manipulation, PPE and explicit medical recipient for pain/abnormality. Aftercare retains moisture/skin folds/pressure-site checks, product-bound moisturizer, garment comfort, rest/drinks per capability/plan and no universal fluid amount.

Washing, drying and combing are separate.14:20choice/retrieval consent directly checked, own retrieval/changing not begun;15:00washing separate-team plan with result unknown, neither finished nor confirmed unperformed. Kishimoto checks and shares results; later new information is updated with who/what/time rather than retroactively treated as known. Alternate15:45towel choice versus16:00face-wash plan and Kishimoto completed drying/Tanaka utensil check/person future combing remain separate.

Marked personal comb and authorized box-only search retained; not found does not establish lost, other locations unconfirmed, owner-unknown comb not used and grooming not begun. Additional search requires new permission. Face-towel alternative preserves permitted basket, blue border, unknown unbordered owner and face-only help while hands remain self-care.

Supplemental infection scene is a simulation with no real contaminated cloth/care or hands-on glove/handwashing. Main scene:9:40used cloth received, no screen contact, clean-handed Kishimoto enters data, next task not begun, no record of completed hand hygiene. Absence of record is not proof of nonperformance. Separate card/reading scenario explicitly has used-glove contact at screen edge and no screen response yet; report to responsible Kawase, do not merge opposite contact facts.

Standard precautions depend on exposure risk even without diagnosis. Used-glove exterior may be contaminated despite no tear; glove change does not clean screen or replace hand hygiene. Visible soil requires liquid soap/running water per trained facility method; PPE varies by task, no guessed chemical/concentration/time or guarantee of zero infection risk.
